verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Hugging Face search and download (in the app and via `lms get`) and a Bionic agent for documents and agentic tasks. Nothing shows an AI assistant, or any feature, that recommends a model based on the user's hardware or task before download. Plain search and download is an adjacent feature, not the recommendation capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
